agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A deterministic provider-free controller must run under the repository's exact provider-free pytest wrapper, including its removal of LOCALAPPDATA, without silently widening environment passthrough.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first isolated Gemini review found seven current-suite failures because the controller's default cache root required LOCALAPPDATA even though the exact wrapper removes it.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Gemini executed the exact isolated-worktree C03 command and returned revision_required with the failing trace and affected source boundary.

correction.action: Use LOCALAPPDATA when present, otherwise select the first existing non-symlink user-owned AppData/Local/npm-cache in repository ancestry, and fail closed when no owned candidate exists.
correction.prevention_control: Every provider-free controller that needs a user-local cache must be tested under the exact environment-stripping wrapper and with a no-owned-candidate negative fixture before independent dispatch.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the stripped-LOCALAPPDATA failure and the exact owned-cache fallback plus fail-closed test.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every verifier-manifest test must be transferable into its clean Git worktree or be explicitly excluded with equivalent candidate-owned evidence for the exact protected boundary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first verifier manifest included a predecessor evidence test that requires the physical user-owned untracked docs/branding directory, which a clean Git-created review worktree cannot contain.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Gemini's exact isolated C03 command failed the predecessor preservation assertion and returned revision_required; Sol verified the test's accepted primary-worktree purpose and non-transferability.

correction.action: Exclude only the non-transferable predecessor evidence test from the isolated manifest, preserve that test unchanged for the primary worktree, and directly hash-check both immutable attempts in the current candidate suite.
correction.prevention_control: Verifier-manifest construction classifies every selected test as Git-transferable or primary-worktree-only before dispatch and requires an explicit equivalent evidence binding for any justified exclusion.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the non-transferable untracked-path assertion and the manifest transferability classification control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The terminal structured envelope must reproduce each executed command id and argv exactly from the injected manifest so local evidence admission can bind execution without model transcription drift.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The corrected reviewer executed C10 as git status --short --branch and completed all ten commands at exit zero, but reported C10 argv as git diff status --short --branch; the broker admitted no verdict.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Exact local command-result admission returned zero schema-valid envelopes; read-only inspection of the retained conversation record isolated the single extra diff token while the worktree remained unchanged.

correction.action: Preserve the non-admitted receipt, start one fresh project, repeat the complete exact manifest, and require verbatim manifest id and argv copying with C10 called out explicitly.
correction.prevention_control: The broker continues exact local argv admission; recovery packets explicitly direct reviewers to copy injected command results rather than reconstruct them, and no semantic verdict is inferred from rejected output.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the C10 argv mistranscription and the exact local admission plus fresh-project recovery control.

correction.action: Preserve the failed publication evidence, roll back byte-exactly, materialise the machine-derived revision-568 companion note, and require its file existence in prepublication verification.
correction.prevention_control: Every incident-intake closeout takes the prospective revision from a dry clockwork reading and validates the corresponding versioned register note before live publication; canonical register fields remain clockwork-derived.
